title: Legendrian position of veering triangulations
summary: We make a first step towards connecting the theory of veering triangulations and bicontact structures as tools for studying (pseudo-)Anosov flows: We show that given a veering triangulation corresponding to an Anosov flow with orientable stable and unstable foliations, the edges of the triangulation can be realized as Legendrian arcs with respect to a strongly adapted bicontact structure that supports the Anosov flow.
